title: Australian Overseas Relocation Agency
titleZh: 澳大利亚海外安置机构

parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one.

You will hear a telephone conversation between a woman who is planning to move to Australia and a relocation agent who is helping her with the arrangements.

1st, you have some time to look at questions one to 6.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to 6.

Hello, Australian Overseas Relocation Agency. This is Jason here.

Oh, hello. Yes, I'm calling from London. My husband has just got a new job in Australia, and his company recommended you to help us.

Great. I'll get some details from you. Let's start with your name, shall we?

Oh, yes. It's Helen Green.

Thank you. And what's your current address?

It's a London address, 42 Station Road, Kew. It's just near the Botanical Gardens.

Oh, that sounds nice. And in case I need to contact you, could I have a telephone number?

Yes, it's O207 9460385.

Got it. Now, Helen, whereabouts in Australia are you relocating to?

Brisbane.

And is your husband's company paying for the move?

Yes, it's a company called Kirkby Technology.

I think we've worked with them before. And how soon do you need to move?

Well, they want my husband to start work in 2 weeks, at the start of the month, but school doesn't finish here until the end of July, so we can't possibly move until then.

Shall we say the beginning of August then?

That sounds more realistic. June is nearly over, and I have so much to do before we move.

Let's start with the accommodation you need. Would you prefer a house or an apartment?

Well, we live in a big house with a garden now, which we love, but I think that initially we'd be happy with an apartment that's fairly central, just until we get to know the city a little better and can find a house we love.

Sounds like a good idea. And what about location? There are some beautiful developments along the Brisbane River. It runs right through the city. The views are spectacular, and you wouldn't need to worry about transport.

Well, actually, as we won't have our own garden, I'd prefer something close to a park. That's more important than a view for us.

Okay, I'll make a note of that.

Brisbane's a lovely green city, so that won't be hard. Is there anything else I can organize?

Oh, yes, furniture. We were planning to ship our own, but we've decided it isn't really worth it.

Okay. Well, we can hire some for you for the 1st few months.

That would be great.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 7 to 10.

Now listen and answer questions 7 to 10.

Now, Helen, what else would you like us to help you with?

Well, we have a son, a teenager, who will be coming with us, so we'll need to find a school for him.

Sure. What grade will he be in?

He's just turned 13, so he should be going into grade 9, but we've decided it would be better if he repeats grade 8.

Right, so you'll need a high school. Now, do you have any preferences regarding the school?

Well, he's at a state school at the moment, but the company is prepared to pay his school fees, so we would probably go for private school if possible. It doesn't matter if it's mixed or single-sex.

Sure. I'll make some inquiries, and I'll send you a shortlist of possibilities.

That would be wonderful.

Oh, can you send me a copy of your son's report? The latest one, if possible. The schools will want to know something about him as a student. You can fax or scan it to me.

Okay, fine.

Now, is there anything else I can help you with today?

Yes, there is one other thing. We'd like some information to help us settle into the community and make friends. My son isn't really into sport, but he's a keen chess player. He'd like to continue playing when we move to Brisbane. Could you find out about a club for him?

Certainly. I'll make inquiries for you.

And I play the flute, so I'd like to find a band that I could join, if possible.

Music is very popular here, so that should be easy.

Thank you for all your help, Jason.

My pleasure. I'll be in touch soon.

That is the end of Part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to Part one.

analyses.content: 中介询问地址时，客户给出了完整地址“42 Station Road”，结合题干直接填入缺少的路名 station 即可。
你可能会因为注意力全集中在前面的数字 42 上而漏听了紧跟在后面的路名 station，做题时一定要利用题干里的 Road 来预判。
And what's your current address? It's a London address, 42 Station Road, Kew. It's just near the Botanical Gardens.
听到中介索要电话号码（telephone number）后，客户直接报出了这串数字，完整记录下来即可。
你可能会把录音里读作字母“O”的音当成别的词而卡住，要记住在英语电话号码中“O”就是代表数字 0。
And in case I need to contact you, could I have a telephone number? Yes, it's O207 9460385.
客户明确表示七月底之前没法搬家，中介提议定在“八月初（beginning of August）”并得到确认，beginning 完美对应题干的 early。
你极有可能听到 2 weeks 或者 July 就急忙填上去，做这种带有商量性质的题目一定要听到最后双方达成共识的那个时间。

And how soon do you need to move? Well, they want my husband to start work in 2 weeks, at the start of the month, but school doesn't finish here until the end of July, so we can't possibly move until then. Shall we say the beginning of August then? That sounds more realistic.
客户明确表示刚开始（initially 对应 at first）想要找一个比较靠近市中心的公寓（apartment）。
你可能会听到客户前半句说的 big house 就直接填上，完全忽略了题目问的是“一开始（at first）需要的”住宿类型。

Let's start with the accommodation you need. Would you prefer a house or an apartment? Well, we live in a big house with a garden now, which we love, but I think that initially we'd be happy with an apartment that's fairly central, just until we get to know the city a little better and can find a house we love.
面对中介推销的江景房，客户明确拒绝并表示自己更偏向找靠近公园（close to a park 对应 near a）的房子。
中介叽里呱啦说了一大堆关于 Brisbane River 和 view 的废话，你如果不死死盯住表示客户真实态度的词（prefer），很容易被带偏。

And what about location? There are some beautiful developments along the Brisbane River. It runs right through the city. The views are spectacular, and you wouldn't need to worry about transport. Well, actually, as we won't have our own garden, I'd prefer something close to a park. That's more important than a view for us. Okay, I'll make a note of that.
客户主动提起家具（furniture）不想海运过来了，随后同意了中介帮忙在当地租用的提议，说明他们需要解决家具问题。
听到 ship our own 时你可能会以为客户自己有就不需要了，但一定要听懂后面转折的意思是他们最终要在当地租（hire some）。

Is there anything else I can organize? Oh, yes, furniture. We were planning to ship our own, but we've decided it isn't really worth it. Okay. Well, we can hire some for you for the 1st few months. That would be great.
客户说儿子本来该上 9 年级，但最终决定让他重读 8 年级（repeats grade 8）。
你极其容易把最先听到的 grade 9 当成答案直接写上，绝对不能忽略转折词 but 后面真正确认的信息。
What grade will he be in? He's just turned 13, so he should be going into grade 9, but we've decided it would be better if he repeats grade 8.

Now, do you have any preferences regarding the school? Well, he's at a state school at the moment, but the company is prepared to pay his school fees, so we would probably go for private school if possible. It doesn't matter if it's mixed or single-sex.
客户说明由于公司可以报销学费，所以他们很可能会选择私立学校（private school），完美对应题干的 preferably。
录音先抛出了现在的 state school（公立学校）当烟雾弹，你不看清题干问的是“偏好的学校（preferably）”，就会被直接套路。
中介要求客户发一份儿子最近的成绩单（son's report），客户回答 Okay 表示同意。
听到 copy 你可能会想直接填上，但我们要填的是具体的核心物品名词，也就是所有格 son's 后面的 report。
Oh, can you send me a copy of your son's report? The latest one, if possible. The schools will want to know something about him as a student. You can fax or scan it to me. Okay, fine.
客户提到自己吹长笛，想找个乐队（band）加入（join 对应题干的 play in）。
你的思维可能还停留在上文给儿子找国际象棋俱乐部上，没有意识到主语已经切换成客户自己了（I play...）。
And I play the flute, so I'd like to find a band that I could join, if possible. Music is very popular here, so that should be easy.
